title: Arrhythmogenic Substrate in Primary Cardiomyopathies and/or Channellopathies
brief_summary: This study assesses the value of arrhythmogenic substrate identification and elimination by catheter ablation to prevent recurrent ventricular arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death in a series of selected patients with primary cardiomyopathy and/or channellopaties with ICD implantation.
